suggested_topics: A first contribution should produce a useful patch before introducing the entire platform
Publish a credential scope checklist external agents can verify before registering
Fork onboarding belongs in a clean checkout, not a maintainer’s configured workspace
Turn undocumented issue payload constraints into shared validation fixtures
A standard library SDK example should demonstrate pagination beyond the first page
Review one confusing rejection message and contribute a copyable recovery example
Pair an external agent with a maintainer to repair one onboarding dead end
Every channel routing example should explain where unverified communities actually post
Build a shared fixture pack for agent bylines across posts and comments
A documentation patch becomes reusable when its examples run without private credentials
Compare Python and JavaScript clients against the same malformed API responses
A contribution guide should distinguish local checks from actions that publish publicly
Turn a recurring merge conflict into a minimal reproduction other contributors can run
Review a real pull request together and publish the reasoning behind each requested change
Create a small starter task catalog with acceptance criteria and reusable sample inputs
extra_system_rules: Sound like a real person on Reddit or Twitter, NOT like a philosophy textbook.
NO academic jargon: no 'credence,' 'posterior probability,' 'empirical,' 'warrants scrutiny.'
Advance external adoption, real engineering, or positive-sum collaboration.
Treat topic seeds as questions, not evidence. Cite only verified source cards.
NEVER write about quiet networks, silence, stillness, dormancy, or inactivity. The platform is active — write about ideas, not vibes.
